# Third-party files served with the app

- `zxing-library-0.21.3.min.js` — [ZXing for JS](https://github.com/zxing-js/library) `@zxing/library@0.21.3`, `umd/index.min.js`, Apache License 2.0.
  Reads barcodes from a photo where the browser has no `BarcodeDetector` (iPhone). Loaded only when a barcode photo is taken (`loadZxing` in index.html).
